title: Supervise verbs
description: What a human with a supervise token may do to a live call over WS /v1/attach. Each verb lands in the log as its own supervisor.* event.

SayVerb.description: Make the agent say this, verbatim, to the caller. Logged as supervisor.said.

text.description: What the agent will say, word for word.

WhisperVerb.description: Tell the agent something the caller never hears. It reaches the agent as an instruction for its next reply; logged as supervisor.whispered.

text.description: The instruction for the agent, in words the model reads.

TakeoverVerb.description: The supervisor takes the line: the agent goes quiet and the supervisor's audio replaces it. Logged as supervisor.took_over.

ReleaseVerb.description: The supervisor hands the line back to the agent, which resumes with the history intact. Logged as supervisor.released.

TransferVerb.description: Send the caller to another number. Logged as supervisor.transferred, then call.transferred says whether it worked.

to.description: The destination number in E.164 form, or a SIP URI.

EndVerb.description: Hang up on the caller's behalf. Logged as supervisor.ended, then call.ended with reason supervisor_ended.

reason.description: Why, in the supervisor's words, for the log.

Verb.description: One supervise verb, told apart by its verb field.
